KWG 44(1) extends information, copies and inspection powers to outsourcing undertakings, organs and employees. ICT providers within this broad outsourcing category are covered; no categorical omission identified.

KWG 25a(1) mandates legal compliance, technical organisation and IT emergency management; DORA applies directly, 6(1g) designates supervision and 2(2)/(2a) extends or simplifies its application for specified institutions.
KWG 25a(1) no5 plus directly applicable DORA Article 11 provides the ICT continuity route; no absent plan obligation inferred from generic statutory language.
